## ENFORCEMENT NOTICE
Pursuant to the powers conferred by the Deregulation Act 2015, Section 44, and the Housing Act 2004, Part 3 (particularly Sections 22 and 28), this Notice is served on **Liliya** in respect of the short‑term let identified by Airbnb listing ID **1100795056480260906** at **Westminster, London**.  The operator has permitted the letting of the whole property for **239 nights** in the preceding 365‑day period, which exceeds the statutory annual limit of **90 nights** established by the Deregulation Act 2015, s.44.  Accordingly, the breach constitutes an unlawful short‑term let under the Housing Act 2004 and is subject to enforcement action.

## EVIDENCE SUMMARY
The Airbnb listing (ID 1100795056480260906) is hosted by **Liliya** at a property in **Westminster, London**.  In the last 365 days the listing was booked for **239 nights**, **149 nights** above the legal limit of 90 nights.  An algorithmic confidence score of **0.97** confirms the accuracy of this data, and the operator controls only **one** property.

## RECOMMENDED ACTION
Prosecution
